title: Anduril arrow link
description: A small text link with a ↗ arrow and a hairline underline under the words; on hover the underline draws itself again from the left in 300ms. Can also hide the underline until hover, or render as a span inside a bigger link.
notes: as="span" for use inside a card or row that is itself the link
name: anduril-link

props.name: underline
props.description: "always": a hairline under the words that re-draws on hover; "hover": no line until hover

props.name: as
props.description: render as a span, for use inside a card or row that is itself the link
